name: Smartli
summary: AI writing suite for e-commerce: product listings, ad copy, SEO text and brand assets. Each of the nine tools is competent rather than deep, so leaning hard on one job means outgrowing it.
best_for: e-commerce sellers who want an affordable all-in-one AI suite to draft product listings, ad copy, SEO text and basic brand assets in one place
skip_if: you need best-in-class depth in one area (a specialist copy or image tool), or you won't edit and fact-check AI output before it ships
honest_knock:
Smartli bundles nine AI tools — copy, SEO, images, logos — into one suite, and that breadth is also the honest catch: each individual tool is competent rather than best-in-class, so a team that leans hard on one job may outgrow it toward a specialist. And like all AI copy, its product descriptions and ad copy need a human edit and a fact-check — never publish specs or claims it invents about your product. For a store that wants many content jobs handled cheaply in one place, it's efficient.

Two places tell different stories about trying it for free. The Shopify App Store listing, read on 27 October 2026, says 'Free plan available' and shows a Free card that lists only 24/7 chat support, while smartli.ai/pricing shows four paid tiers and no free plan on either tab. A one-star review from an Australian store, edited 24 July 2024, says the advertised free account was not offered after installing and the app would not allow a test without choosing a plan. If a free tier matters to you, check which plan the app selects before you approve the Shopify charge.

The star average hides a split. Of 66 ratings, 53 are five stars and 4 are one star (4.0 overall), and the one- and two-star reviews are nearly all about billing rather than writing quality: a charge after cancelling inside the trial (May 2023), the free-account complaint above, and the November 2025 review about a $152 charge on the install day. Smartli's terms add that a failed monthly payment may be retried on the same card until you cancel or change the payment method in your account settings, so an expired card does not end the subscription.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-11 and re-read 2026-09-27 on smartli.ai/pricing; Monthly and Yearly tabs both unchanged since 5 Aug 2026) Monthly: Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, Unicorn $299, each with a 7-day free trial. Switch to annual billing and Starter disappears from the table; the rest become Pro $24/mo (billed annually at $288), Empire $57/mo ($684) and Unicorn $79/mo ($948). Starter was $29/mo when we first checked, so the entry price has gone up. Re-read on 27 October 2026 with a plain fetch: smartli.ai/pricing unchanged (monthly Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, Unicorn $299, each with a 7-day trial; yearly Pro $24 billed $288, Empire $57 billed $684, Unicorn $79 billed $948, Starter absent). The Shopify App Store listing, now titled 'Smartli: AI Tools & SEO Writer', shows a Free plan card with 24/7 chat support above the same paid tiers, and says all charges are billed in USD every 30 days.
